name: Befuddlement
summary: Blasts a creature's mind with Psychic damage and stops it from casting spells or taking the Magic action.

m.text: a key ring with no keys

stats.effect:
You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw.

On a failed save, the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the {ref:glossary/magic} action. At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on a success. The effect can also be ended by the *{ref:spell/greater-restoration}*, *{ref:spell/heal}*, or *{ref:spell/wish}* spell.

On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.
